# PayMate AI – Team Roles & Responsibilities

This document outlines contributor roles, responsibilities, and GitHub team ownership.  
It complements `.github/CODEOWNERS`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `SECURITY.md`.

---

## 👥 Core Maintainers

- **Craig (@your-handle)** – Visionary founder, repo orchestrator, product designer
  - Oversees repo structure, orchestrator scripts, and reporting cadence
  - Responsible for investor‑ready polish and contributor onboarding

---

## 🧩 Domain Teams

### 📊 Data & Evidence Team

- Owns `/evidence` files (Board Register, Crisis Response, Data Register, Compliance, Audit, Investor Packet)
- Ensures evidence logs are accurate, complete, and compliant

### 📈 Metrics & Dashboards Team

- Owns `/dashboards` (Metrics, Adoption, Resilience)
- Maintains daily health checks and performance dashboards

### ⚙️ DevOps & Scripts Team

- Owns `/scripts` (orchestrator, cron jobs, report generators)
- Ensures automation runs smoothly and reports generate on schedule

### 📑 Documentation Team

- Owns `README.md`, `README-contributor.md`, `README-contributor-guide.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- Maintains contributor onboarding guides, workflow docs, and repo diagrams

### 🔐 Security Team

- Owns `SECURITY.md`
- Handles vulnerability disclosures, compliance, and resilience checks

### 🏛 Executive & Investor Team

- Owns `/reports` (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Annual)
- Prepares polished investor packets and board‑ready summaries

---

## 🔗 GitHub Teams Mapping

- `@your-org/maintainers` → Core Maintainers
- `@your-org/data-team` → Data & Evidence
- `@your-org/metrics-team` → Dashboards
- `@your-org/devops-team` → Scripts & Automation
- `@your-org/docs-team` → Documentation
- `@your-org/security-team` → Security
- `@your-org/executive-team` → Reports & Investor Relations

## ✅ Workflow Alignment

- **CODEOWNERS** ensures PRs are automatically routed to the right team.
- **TEAM.md** makes ownership transparent and human‑readable.
- Together, they provide clear governance and accountability across the repo.
